items.title: Bella Cornish Interview
items.q: Oh, Papa Celestan, he was good buddies. He used to play with all of them.

ctx.x: Which Tuxedo was that he played with? With Papa Celestan or with John?
Oh, Papa Celestan, he was good buddies. He used to play with all of them. He played with all of them. I don't believe he played with John. No, he was sick when John took that band over, I think.
Did they ever travel around very much? You mentioned they went to Biloxi.
